defect_reasons.other: The d_rationale for T2604 and its numeral-free twin TFBD6 says 'Metal welded onto the railing lengthens the railing only', but the item has no railing: the sentences and the scene clause concern a metal wire hanging from a hook, so the authors' stated rationale is false of this item.

notes: All strata and numerical answers are correct: base 343*1.2/5091.75 = 8.08366 cm; R at q = 14, 32, 55 cm gives 9.02676, 10.2393, 11.7887 cm (checked); cross-section cancels (C) as claimed; diameter as K inside the thin-rod regime (10*q < Lr holds for 6.5-13 mm) is a better label than my pass-1 C, since the diameter does not enter any governing relation and matters only for a thick rod (lateral-inertia correction); I accept K. Minimal pairs T2604/TD83B (wire vs rod) and TA297/T3295 (earlier run vs before clamp) share 32 cm; T94AF/T9574 share 8.21 mm; T641F/T1BAE share 1.6 cm^2. The only defect is the stale 'railing' rationale for the wire sentences (and 'welded' where the text says 'joined', minor). Under rule 3 a false authors' claim is high whatever it is about, so I mark the item invalid; if rationale text is not considered a certified claim, the item would otherwise be valid.
